title: Day 3
text:
Why the fuck is the medical centre 1,700 km away from the hostels? People would die before reaching that place.

If Bruce Wayne were Sindhi, he would still be just as rich, but he would be super fat and would always ask Alfred for chai and koki.

title: Day 2
text: I sometimes wonder how Spy Kids, a fairly simple kids' movie about kids being spies, suddenly drops one of the most philosophical lines ever: that God stays up there because he might be scared of his own creation. Delivered by none other than Steve Buscemi.

title: Day 1: What a fuckall start
text:
I made this website at 2:30 am and at 8:37 my fucking sink fell.

Are these events correlated? Abso-fucking-lutely yes. This is a sign from God.

Or maybe the sign is that I should brush my teeth regularly.
